update transaction set txn_kind = 'transfer', transfer_group_id = #{groupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updatetime = current_timestamp where id in
#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select count(*) from transaction t where (t.consume_name is null or length(trim(t.consume_name)) = 0 or t.consume_code is null or length(trim(t.consume_code)) = 0)
select count(distinct t.transfer_group_id) from transaction t where t.txn_kind = 'transfer' and t.transfer_group_id is not null and length(trim(t.transfer_group_id)) > 0

select t.transfer_group_id as transferGroupId, min(t.transaction_date) as transferDate, count(*) as transactionCount from transaction t where t.txn_kind = 'transfer' and t.transfer_group_id is not null and length(trim(t.transfer_group_id)) > 0
group by t.transfer_group_id order by transferDate desc

select coalesce(nullif(trim(bc.card_name), ''), concat(coalesce(bc.bank_code, ''), ' ', coalesce(bc.card_type_code, ''))) as `key`, round(coalesce(bal.balance, 0), 2) as `value` from fin_bank_account bc left join ( select t.bank_card_id, round(coalesce(t.account_balance, 0), 2) as balance from transaction t where t.account_balance is not null and t.bank_card_id is not null and length(trim(t.bank_card_id)) > 0
and t.id = ( select t2.id from transaction t2 where t2.bank_card_id = t.bank_card_id and t2.account_balance is not null and (t2.deleted is null or t2.deleted = 0) order by t2.transaction_date desc, t2.id desc limit 1 ) ) bal on bal.bank_card_id = bc.id where coalesce(bc.deleted, 0) != 1 order by bc.card_name, bc.bank_code
select coalesce(sum(), 0) from transaction t left join cls_category cat on cat.code = t.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where t.transaction_date >= #{since,jdbcType=DATE}

select coalesce(sum( case when coalesce(t.income_money,0) > 0 then t.income_money when coalesce(t.balance_money,0) < 0 then abs(t.balance_money) else 0 end ), 0) from transaction t where t.transaction_date >= #{since,jdbcType=DATE}

select coalesce(sum(), 0) from transaction t left join cls_category cat on cat.code = t.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where year(t.transaction_date) = #{year,jdbcType=INTEGER} and ( cat.code like '%rent%' or cat.code like '%mortgage%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房贷%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房租%' or cat.code like '%fixed%' )

select t.bank_card_id as `key`, round(coalesce(t.account_balance, 0), 2) as `value` from transaction t where t.account_balance is not null and t.bank_card_id is not null and length(trim(t.bank_card_id)) > 0
and t.id = ( select t2.id from transaction t2 where t2.bank_card_id = t.bank_card_id and t2.account_balance is not null and (t2.deleted is null or t2.deleted = 0) order by t2.transaction_date desc, t2.id desc limit 1 )

select coalesce(sum(), 0) from transaction t left join cls_category cat on cat.code = t.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where t.transaction_date >= #{since,jdbcType=DATE}
and (cat.parent_id = 'FIXED' or cat.code like 'FIXED%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房租%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房贷%')
and (cat.parent_id = 'SHOPPING' or cat.code like 'SHOPPING%')
and (cat.txn_types like '%invest%' or cat.parent_id = 'INVEST' or cat.code like 'INVEST%')
and (cat.parent_id = 'LIVING' or cat.code like 'LIVING%' or cat.parent_id is null)
and 1 = 1
and (cat.code = #{bucketKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or cat.parent_id = #{bucketKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select coalesce(sum(), 0) from transaction t left join cls_category cat on cat.code = t.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where t.transaction_date >= #{start,jdbcType=DATE} and t.transaction_date <= #{end,jdbcType=DATE}
and (cat.parent_id = 'FIXED' or cat.code like 'FIXED%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房租%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房贷%')
and (cat.parent_id = 'SHOPPING' or cat.code like 'SHOPPING%')
and (cat.txn_types like '%invest%' or cat.parent_id = 'INVEST' or cat.code like 'INVEST%')
and (cat.parent_id = 'LIVING' or cat.code like 'LIVING%' or cat.parent_id is null)
and 1 = 1
and (cat.code = #{bucketKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or cat.parent_id = #{bucketKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select distinct tt.id from imp_staging_entry tt inner join transaction t on date_format(tt.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(t.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d') and round(abs(coalesce(tt.balance_money,0) + coalesce(tt.income_money,0)), 2) = round(abs(coalesce(t.balance_money,0) + coalesce(t.income_money,0)), 2) and coalesce(tt.transaction_desc,'') = coalesce(t.transaction_desc,'') and coalesce(tt.bank_card_id,'') = coalesce(t.bank_card_id,'') and case when coalesce(tt.txn_kind,'') in ('income','expense') then tt.txn_kind when coalesce(tt.income_money,0) > 0 or coalesce(tt.balance_money,0) < 0 then 'income' when coalesce(tt.balance_money,0) > 0 then 'expense' else '' end = case when coalesce(t.txn_kind,'') in ('income','expense') then t.txn_kind when coalesce(t.income_money,0) > 0 or coalesce(t.balance_money,0) < 0 then 'income' when coalesce(t.balance_money,0) > 0 then 'expense' else '' end where tt.statement_id = #{statementId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and coalesce(tt.deleted, 0) = 0 and (t.deleted is null or t.deleted = 0) and (t.txn_kind is null or t.txn_kind = '' or t.txn_kind != 'transfer')
